stem_book: Fill in the blank with appropriate term. (i) ______ are substances that produce ions when dissolved in water. (ii) The degree of ionization is a measure of the fraction of molecules that ______ into ions when a substance is dissolved in water. (iii) A substance with a high degree of ionization is a ______ electrolyte. (iv) Factors affecting the degree of ionization include temperature, ______, and nature of the solute and solvent. (v) The solubility of gas in water ______ with an increase in temperature. (vi) The ionization of ______ electrolytes is not affected by dilution.
key: (i) Electrolytes (ii) dissociate (iii) strong (iv) dilution (v) decreases (vi) strong
derived: (i) Electrolytes (ii) dissociate (iii) strong (iv) dilution/concentration (v) decreases (vi) strong
correct_answer: (i) Electrolytes (ii) dissociate (iii) strong (iv) dilution/concentration (v) decreases (vi) strong
